audience: Trace workspace admins and engineers configuring repositories, members, agent runtimes, credentials, and device access
platform: Desktop web at 1440x900, with one 390x844 mobile artboard for responsive navigation intent
primaryJob: Redesign Trace's nine-tab Settings page into a grouped, scannable settings suite that separates workspace configuration from personal configuration and fixes the weakest interaction patterns
coreFlow: Open Settings and orient via grouped navigation (Workspace vs Your account)
Manage workspace: members and invites, repositories with automation scripts, agent environments, shared secrets, integrations
Manage personal: session defaults, API keys, devices and bridge access
Approve a pending bridge access request with explicit capabilities and duration

direction.name: Console calm
principles: Quiet dark zinc surfaces matching the Trace product; hierarchy from type and spacing, not boxes in boxes
Status is never color alone: dot + label pills for connected/offline/configured
White primary action, emerald reserved for healthy status, amber for attention, red only for destructive
Desktop density: 13-14px body, 32-36px controls, generous section rhythm

preserve: Feature inventory: all nine settings areas and their fields
Exact domain vocabulary: role names (Admin/Member/Observer), capability labels (Sessions/Terminal), grant durations (1 hour/3 hours/1 day), tool and model labels
reinterpret: Flat nine-tab navigation becomes grouped Workspace vs Your account navigation
Channels scripts tab folds into Repositories automation
Search-only member adding becomes invite-by-email with pending invites
avoidCopying: Triple-nested card styling in Bridge Access
evidence: Read directly from SettingsPage.tsx and its nine section components in trace/apps/web/src/components/settings/
Model and tool labels from trace/packages/shared/src/models.ts; capability and duration labels from trace/apps/web/src/lib/bridge-access.ts
Sample people, repos, and dates are placeholder data

assumptions: The audit and redesign target the web app's SettingsPage; the mobile app settings are out of scope except one responsive navigation artboard
The 'Channels' tab (setup/run scripts for coding channels) is folded into Repositories as per-repo automation, since scripts conceptually belong to the codebase being run
'Org Secrets' is renamed 'Secrets' under Workspace; personal 'API Keys' stays under Your account so credential ownership is unambiguous
Invite-by-email with pending invites is proposed to replace search-only member adding (current UX dead-ends when the user has not signed up)

The Session automation dialog unifies the repo ApplicationConfigDialog (setup scripts with env secrets, applications, processes, ports) with channel run scripts into one repo-level editor, since members meet them as one job: how sessions run this codebase
